IKEA has leaned in hard, announcing 10 more small-format US stores for 2026 across two waves (IKEA FY25 Annual Summary). Sprouts is running a 140+ location approved pipeline behind its 40+ planned 2026 openings. [...] ### What is a retail store expansion strategy?

A retail store expansion strategy is a plan for growing your business through new locations, sales channels, or product lines. It includes market analysis, site selection criteria, financial planning, operational scaling, and risk management. The strategies that hold up are data-driven, balancing growth targets against sustainable operations and a consistent customer experience across every location.

title: Amazon plans record 300k holiday hires as the rest of retail pulls back – GeekWire
content:
Amazon says it plans to hire more than 300,000 people for seasonal, part-time and full-time roles across its U.S. operations this holiday season, an increase of 20% from last year and its largest holiday hiring target on record.

The increase reflects a mix of factors, including new sites opening across the country as Amazon expands its operations network, a spokesperson said in response to questions. [...] UPS plans to hire more than 100,000 seasonal workers, about 9% fewer than last year, according to Reuters, after cutting the volume it handles for Amazon, which now delivers most of its own packages. Target and Walmart haven’t announced national hiring goals.

Amazon’s sales volume has picked up this year. Worldwide paid units, a measure of items sold on Amazon, grew 17% year-over-year in the second quarter, up from 12% a year earlier, according to its second-quarter earnings release. [...] Amazon is moving in the opposite direction from the rest of retail. Retailers added the fewest seasonal workers since 2008 last holiday season, and outplacement firm Challenger, Gray & Christmas expects even fewer this year, citing automation and uncertain holiday spending as tariffs keep prices high.
